_note: A Deck as it ships: zram only, no swap file. The five unit parameter values are the boot values measured on the real Deck (docs/unit-params-sudo-stdin.md section 8.3): always / advise / 20 / 5 / 1. Huge Pages and shared memory in THP therefore read recommended=true, because Valve already ships the recommended value. Swappiness, zram size and VRAM are illustrative.
